# columns: source_concept = lexical or grammatical source meaning; target_function = the gram it becomes; intermediate_stages = typical bridging stages (' > ' ordered); fusion_endpoint = how bound the marker typically ends up; frequency_class = very common (many families on several continents) | common | attested (a handful of families); example = one or two real-language cases (romanized; tone marks and some diacritics dropped).
# frequency classes are judgement, not counts. Paths are unidirectional in the normal case (lexical > grammatical).
